_note: Item 6 (spec §2.5, OD-91): the ONE per-field document-family table, keyed by the field manifest's documentType. A document can carry (and so supersede) a field only when its type is in that field's family; a field with no documentType has the chosen document's own type as its only family member. Read by scraper/config/plan-supersession-rule.mjs, which both the scraper (decidePlanRowSupersession, the DOC fetcher) and the PULL-FROZEN audit use.
